context_title: The video is an official music video / entrance video titled 'Trouble' by WWE Superstar Liv Morgan. It follows an edited non-linear story intercut with high-energy dance choreography. The narrative begins in an underground parking garage where Liv Morgan, dressed in black high-heeled boots, walks carrying a red gasoline container. She douses a convertible car and lights it on fire with a Zippo lighter, while wearing a crop top reading 'I [HEART] TROUBLE'. Additional storylines show her out at a neon-lit arcade/pool bar with a friend, walking across bar stool tops, receiving a lower back tattoo in a tattoo studio, and biting a black leather choker with silver letters spelling 'DADDY DOM'. The video also features an underground fight club sequence where she spars with a opponent in front of a crowd. Towards the conclusion, police officers apprehend and arrest her in the parking structure while she screams and smiles. The video finishes with a police mugshot slate reading 'LIV MORGAN', 'BAD DECISIONS', and inmate ID '18190426' (an Easter egg for WrestleMania 42 on April 18-19, 2026), ending on a final dance frame in the garage
